body: A programming framework for agentic AI
plain_description: AutoGen enables you to build AI applications that coordinate multiple specialized agents to work together autonomously or with human oversight. You can create assistants, automated workflows, and code-generation agents with minimal setup, and prototype interactively using AutoGen Studio's no-code interface. Note: AutoGen is now in maintenance mode; Microsoft recommends its successor, Microsoft Agent Framework, for new production deployments.
technical_description: AutoGen is a multi-agent AI framework with a three-layer architecture: Core API provides event-driven message passing, distributed runtime, and cross-language support for Python and .NET via gRPC; AgentChat API offers an opinionated high-level interface for rapid prototyping of multi-agent patterns (group chat, two-agent chat, tool use); Extensions API enables pluggable integrations for LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Gemini, Ollama), code execution (Docker, local, Jupyter), MCP tools, web browsing, and file handling. AutoGen Studio provides a no-code web GUI for prototyping, and Magentic-One delivers a pre-built multi-agent team for complex tasks. The framework is in maintenance mode; its successor is Microsoft Agent Framework.
title: AutoGen
